title: 第15章 只缘身在此山中第16章 黑暗纪元
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
早晨，病态的少年一步一步踏过木梯下了阁楼。
庭院之内，阳光之下，少年转头看着阁楼牌匾上“朝暮居”三个字微笑。
“谢谢！”
左丘辰发自肺腑的感谢，自己又多活了一天。
每天左丘辰除了想念族人和报仇的事情，更多的便是对慕容仙儿的感激。
还梦深魇内黑暗中那张天使般的脸，带着自信，带着无畏，奋不顾身救下了九死一生的自己，此情无以回报，此后余生能做的就是活着好好报答这位神仙般的女子...
曾几何时，一路而来，看着他们一个个死去在自己眼前，左丘辰早已经没有了那颗活下去的信心，但是一想到深魇中那个白色身影，嘴角还是会微微翘起。
“以前我不知道是谁，想为了族人而活，可是我终究不是左丘的希望。”
“现在至少我会为了报恩而活吧...”
少年低语，然后朝着那棵巨大槐树走去。
木屋内，慕容仙儿收回看着窗外的眼神，眼中那个孱弱的身影也是照常坐在树下。
美目一转，桌上几物散发的光芒，慕容仙儿从未这样紧张，紧握的双手出现点点汗粒，洁白的牙齿咬了咬下嘴唇。
“今天好像更冷了，咳...咳，北境的冬天那么美，雪花是那么耀眼，可惜不是为我绽放。”
背靠槐树的少年眼带希翼，这几天虽然噩梦没有再次出现，但是那种无力，快要虚脱的感觉却是那么明显。
“左丘辰，我救你不是看着你等死的，我不想看到你这样放弃自己。”
“不要悲伤，我要一个乐观，活泼的对着阳光微笑的少年。”
赫然来自慕容仙儿的声音响在左丘辰耳边，树下闭眼的病态少年瞬间睁开眼转头看着朝暮居，灵动的双眼和清晨的阳光交织。
漆黑深邃的眼珠目不转睛的看着那个小小的木屋，像是看到了生命中最重要的东西。
这一刻，左丘辰认真聆听慕容仙儿的话语。
“抬头看，朝暮居之上乃是半斜半倾的山峰，给你一天时间登山顶，然后你去看看上另一边是什么。”

“若是无法达到山顶，那么你便死在朝暮山吧！”
听到此话，左丘辰先是一惊，然后抬头看去，的确朝暮居位于此山的半山腰之上，离山巅还有不少距离，虽然看上去不高大，但是山就是这样横看成岭侧成峰，远近高低各不同...
“咕噜”
左丘辰喉结鼓动，他知道这是一个考验，若是普通修士登此山，身法灵动者最多不过两个时辰，换做普通人也许半日。
可是现在，自己全身乏力，胸口的伤口才开始愈合，左丘辰看着这朝暮山，就像看着一个巨人般，难以征服...
“小主，活下去！”
“我北境男儿，从不气馁！”
“那么你便死在朝暮山吧！”
双脚一蹬，扬起碎叶黄土，少年瘦弱的身影一个箭步朝着高大的朝暮山而去。
红唇抿嘴一笑，慕容仙儿点头，觉得这才像个样子，下一刻白色身影出现在阁楼之上，负手看着林中急窜的左丘辰...
半刻后，双脚踏过枯叶，叶底泥土松动，左丘辰苍白的脸更加明显，嘴中大口呼气。
对于身体还不如常人的左丘辰来说，登上这么一座高大山峰，显然是很有难度的，最重要的是还有伤在身。
“不能放弃！”
手掌一把抓在大树上，左丘辰顺势用力继续前行，额头冷汗冒出，身体内热外冷，越往上越是寒冷。
踏过小山包，绿油油的青苔让这个瘦弱身影跌倒，手掌膝盖摩擦在光滑的石头上。
“身为北境男儿，左丘的勇士，不能放弃！”
披头散发的左丘辰怒目言道，握紧双拳站起，目标只有一个，那就是不断向上，向上...
一个时辰后，少年脸上被利刺刮了好几道口子，衣襟也是破碎，像是一个原始森林中的野人，但是眼中那股坚定的信念没有动摇。
又过了一个时辰，鲜血沁透了胸膛，握住胸口的左丘辰缓慢前行，眼前除了高大的巨石和树木，更多就是灌木，根本没有路，一步一步强迫自己直线向前，不然在天黑前，左丘辰很难到达山顶。
“毅力和承受能力还算可以，毕竟受了那么多打击，你现在所受的生离死别，所有的苦难，以后都将成为动力！”

唇红齿白的白色身影站在木屋之顶轻声道，而山林中的左丘辰还在奋力朝前，两个时辰后左丘辰已经攀登了大半朝暮山了。
content_en:
In the morning, the sickly boy stepped down the wooden ladder step by step to the attic.
In the courtyard, under the sunshine, the young man turned his head and looked at the three words "Chao Mu Residence" on the attic plaque and smiled.
"Thank you!"
Zuo Qiuchen expressed his heartfelt thanks for living another day.
Every day, Zuo Qiuchen not only misses his tribe and revenge, but also feels more grateful to Murong Xianer.
The angelic face in the darkness of the deep nightmare, with confidence and fearlessness, risked his own life to save himself from a narrow escape. There is no way to repay this love. All I can do for the rest of my life is to live and repay this fairy-like woman...
Once upon a time, Zuo Qiuchen, who had come all the way and watched them die one by one in front of his eyes, had long since lost the confidence to live, but when he thought of the white figure in the deep nightmare, the corners of his mouth still curled up slightly.
"I didn't know who I was before. I wanted to live for my clan, but after all, I was not Zuoqiu's hope."
"Now at least I will live to repay my kindness..."
The young man whispered, and then walked towards the huge locust tree.
In the wooden house, Murong Xianer looked away from the window and saw the frail figure sitting under the tree as usual.
As her beautiful eyes turned, the objects on the table radiated light. Murong Xianer had never been so nervous. There were beads of sweat in her clenched hands, and she bit her lower lip with her white teeth.
"It seems to be colder today, cough... cough, the winter in the north is so beautiful, and the snowflakes are so dazzling, but it's a pity that they don't bloom for me."
The young man leaning against the locust tree had hope in his eyes. Although the nightmare had not reappeared in the past few days, the feeling of weakness and impending collapse was so obvious.
"Zuo Qiuchen, I didn't save you just to wait for you to die. I don't want to see you give up on yourself like this."
"Don't be sad, I want an optimistic, lively boy who smiles at the sun."
The sudden voice from Murong Xian'er rang in Zuo Qiuchen's ears. The sickly boy with his eyes closed under the tree instantly opened his eyes and turned to look at Chao Muju, his smart eyes intertwined with the morning sunshine.
The dark and deep eyes stared at the small wooden house intently, as if they were seeing the most important thing in life.
At this moment, Zuo Qiuchen listened carefully to Murong Xianer's words.
"Look up and see that there is a half-sloping mountain peak above Chaomuju. Give you one day to climb to the top, and then go and see what's on the other side."
"If you can't reach the top of the mountain, then you will die on Chaomu Mountain!"
Hearing this, Zuo Qiuchen was startled at first, and then looked up. It was true that Chaomuju was located halfway up the mountain, quite far away from the top of the mountain. Although it didn't look very tall, the mountain looked like this from side to side, with ridges and peaks at different distances...
"Gulu"
Zuo Qiuchen's Adam's apple twitched. He knew that this was a test. If an ordinary monk climbed this mountain, it would only take two hours at most for those with agile body skills. For an ordinary person, it would take maybe half a day.
But now, his whole body was weak, and the wound on his chest had just begun to heal. Zuo Qiuchen looked at Chaomu Mountain as if he were looking at a giant that was difficult to conquer...
"My lord, stay alive!"
"I, a man from the north, never get discouraged!"
"Then you will die in Chaomu Mountain!"
With a kick of his feet, broken leaves and loess were thrown up, and the young man's thin figure headed towards the tall Chaomu Mountain in one stride.
With a pursed smile on her red lips, Murong Xianer nodded, feeling that this was the right thing to do. The next moment, a white figure appeared on the attic, looking at Zuo Qiuchen who was running hurriedly in the forest with his hands behind his back...
Half a moment later, his feet stepped on the dead leaves, and the soil at the bottom of the leaves loosened. Zuo Qiuchen's pale face became more obvious, and he exhaled heavily from his mouth.
For Zuo Qiuchen, whose body is not as good as that of ordinary people, it is obviously very difficult to climb such a tall mountain. The most important thing is that he is still injured.
"Can't give up!"
Grabbing the big tree with his palms, Zuo Qiuchen continued to move forward with all his strength. Cold sweat broke out on his forehead, and his body was hot inside and cold outside.It gets colder as you go up.
Stepping over the hill, the green moss made the thin figure fall down, and his hands and knees rubbed against the smooth stones.
"As a man from the north, a warrior from Zuoqiu, you can't give up!"
The disheveled Zuo Qiuchen said angrily, clenched his fists and stood up with only one goal, which is to keep going up, up...
An hour later, the young man's face was scratched several times by sharp thorns, and his clothes were torn. He looked like a savage in the primeval forest, but the firm belief in his eyes did not waver.
An hour later, blood filled his chest. Zuo Qiuchen held his chest and moved forward slowly. In addition to tall boulders and trees, there were mostly shrubs in front of him. There was no road at all. He forced himself to move forward step by step. Otherwise, it would be difficult for Zuo Qiuchen to reach the top of the mountain before dark.
"Perseverance and endurance are not bad. After all, you have suffered so many blows. The life and death you are suffering now, and all the suffering, will become motivation in the future!"
The white figure with red lips and white teeth stood on the top of the wooden house and whispered softly, while Zuo Qiuchen in the mountain forest was still struggling to move forward. Two hours later, Zuo Qiuchen had climbed most of Chaomu Mountain.
